docs.title: Profile
docs.body:
# Alice
- Runs a small home lab with Docker Compose stacks. (as of 2026-10-01)
- Prefers short status reports with one recommended next step. (as of 2026-10-14)

docs.title: Deployment safety
docs.body:
- Separates repository changes, image publication and live deployment.
- Tests a candidate on an isolated port before a cutover.
- Backs up production state and checks the rollback first.

docs.title: Dashboard style
docs.body:
- Wants tables for comparisons and lists for parallel items.
- Avoids decorative cards and all-caps labels.
- Expects visible keyboard focus and a dark theme.

docs.title: Example gateway
docs.body:
# Example gateway
A reverse proxy stack in front of the lab services. It reloads its configuration gracefully; a restart drops open sessions.

docs.title: Notes wiki
docs.body:
# Notes wiki
A Markdown knowledge base. Agents write through its API, never into its volume.

docs.title: Backup restore drill
docs.body: On 2026-10-20 a restore drill of the database volume passed in 4 minutes. The drill used a copy, not the live volume.

docs.title: DNS cache after a move
docs.body:
Problem: a moved service kept the old address for one hour.
Cause: a long TTL on the local resolver.
Fix: lower the TTL a day before a move.
